library.type.title: Library type
library.type.description: School uses course, module, shift, ranking and thesis. Standard uses a category and hides academic features.
library.type.confirm.title: Change library type?
library.type.confirm.to_standard:
The Standard library hides academic features across the whole system (panel and app): course, module and shift are replaced by a generic category, and the Ranking and Thesis pages are no longer shown.

No data is deleted — switching back to School brings everything back.
library.type.confirm.to_school: The School library re-enables academic features across the whole system (panel and app): course, module and shift become required again when registering readers, and the Ranking and Thesis pages are shown again.
library.type.success.title: Library type updated
library.type.success.description: The change now applies to the panel and the app.
library.type.error.title: Failed to change library type
library.type.error.description: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.
